chain.description: Chain, e.g. Base, Ethereum, Gnosis. Required when a venue's stage is measured on more than one chain — series are never blended across chains. Omit for venue-level rows.

grain.description: 'weekly' (the citable series, default) or 'daily' (the trend grain; never a headline).

mode.description: 'stage' (default) is one venue/chain/stage series. 'movers' is the week's Sato Score movement across the directory — which listings rose, fell, crossed a tier, were scored for the first time, or answered our daily checks differently. In movers mode venue, chain and stage are ignored.

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage. REQUIRED in 'stage' mode. By venue: erc8004 = registered, registered_new_1d (daily), active_7d, mcp_endpoint_answers; olas = registered, working; virtuals = launched; virtuals_acp = jobs_created; x402 = settled_to_catalogued_seller, answers_402, facilitator_txs_1d_known (daily).

venue.description: Venue id: erc8004, olas, virtuals, virtuals_acp, x402, erc4337_accounts. Optional: when omitted, a stage that one venue reports is read from that venue, and a stage several venues report (registered) returns one separate series per venue. Pass it to read exactly one. See onchain_agent_get_agent_economy for the catalogue.
